# Expenses

This page explains which costs the company reimburses and how to claim them.

## What can be claimed

Travel, accommodation and meals during business trips can be claimed, as can books, courses and equipment agreed with your manager in advance. Personal items, fines and upgrades to a higher travel class are not reimbursed.

## Approval

Expenses above 500 euros need manager approval before the money is spent. Smaller amounts can be claimed afterwards without prior approval, as long as they follow this policy. The approval workflow was introduced under the name CEDAR-8 and appears with that label in the finance tool.

## Submitting a claim

Submit claims through the finance tool within sixty days of the purchase. Attach a photo of every receipt and add a short note about the business reason. Claims without receipts are only paid in exceptional cases and need written confirmation from your manager.

## Payment

Approved claims are paid with the next monthly salary. Claims submitted after the twentieth of the month are paid one month later. If a claim is rejected, the finance team explains why and you may correct and resubmit it.

## Company cards

Staff who travel often can request a company card. Card spending follows the same rules and the same approval threshold.
